Name: Farm Combat Grants XP Too
Author: Atravita
TagLine: In vanilla, monster kills on the farm do not grant XP or count towards quests. This mod adds that XP gain back, and makes kills on farm count towards quests
Description:
<s></s>This mod is mostly deprecated. In 1.6, monsters now award 1/3 of xp if killed on farm, and quests have a new field that can allow monsters on farm to count.<s></s>
<s>In vanilla, when you kill a monster on the farm, you get no XP from it; nor does it count towards quests. This mod makes it so you do.</s>

**NOTE: THE XP NUMBERS ARE FROM [UI INFO SUITE 2](https://github.com/Annosz/UIInfoSuite2/releases). THIS MOD DOES NOT ADD XP NUMBERS, IT JUST RESTORES THE ABILITY TO GET XP ON THE FARM.**

Install

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
Config options
Run SMAPI at least once with this mod installed to generate the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font], or use [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098) to configure.

*   [font=Courier New]GainExp[/font] restores full XP gain from monster kills on farm.

*   [font=Courier New]QuestCompletion[/font] counts monster kills on farm towards billboard quest completion.

*   [font=Courier New]SpecialOrderCompletion[/font] counts monster kills on farm towards special order objectives.
Compatibility

*   Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.

*   Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. Can probably be installed by just one player in multiplayer.

See also

*   [Release notes](https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/ExpFromMonsterKillsOnFarm/ExpFromMonsterKillsOnFarm/docs/CHANGELOG.MD)

*   [Source code](https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/ExpFromMonsterKillsOnFarm/ExpFromMonsterKillsOnFarm)

Requires SMAPI, uses Harmony.

All donation points for this mod go to [Against Malaria](https://www.againstmalaria.com/). Please consider supporting them if you like this mod!
Looking for something else? Please consider [my other mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/116553368?tab=user+files)!
